description: This PHP trait defines validation rules for LDAP configuration parameters, including methods for creating parameter rule collections and data mapping rules, used within the LDAP plugin of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPCommonParamRuleCollection
classes.description: A trait providing parameter validation rule collections for LDAP configuration within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Creates and returns a collection of validation rules for core LDAP parameters, such as host, port, encryption, and synchronization settings.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollectionForDataMapping
methods.description: Creates and returns a collection of validation rules for LDAP user data mapping attributes.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollectionForUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Creates and returns a collection of validation rules for LDAP user lookup configuration parameters.
